title: Edison First Gift

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: Well, if it isn't my favorite new purveyor of elegant eels. Get it? Because noodles are the same shape as eels? Ahh—nevermind. How's your new life as a business owner treatin' yah?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, if it isn't my favorite new purveyor of elegant eels. Get it? Because noodles are the same shape as eels? Ahh—nevermind. How's your new life as a business owner treatin' yah?

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: Yeah, well, we're all survivin' best we can. Listen, how about a favor?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, well, we're all survivin' best we can. Listen, how about a favor?

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: It ain't like that. After we talked last time, I remembered I owe Thaddeus. He bailed me out a while back.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It ain't like that. After we talked last time, I remembered I owe Thaddeus. He bailed me out a while back.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: So the favor ain't for me. It's for you! Got some stock that fell off the back of a HOVA. All sorts of fresh produce.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So the favor ain't for me. It's for you! Got some stock that fell off the back of a HOVA. All sorts of fresh produce.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: We have onions so fresh they'll make you cry.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We have onions so fresh they'll make you cry.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: I'm only charging for the delivery. Twenty Lims.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm only charging for the delivery. Twenty Lims.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: Here you go! And if you see Thaddeus around, tell him I'm looking after his old noodle stand, and its new manager.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Here you go! And if you see Thaddeus around, tell him I'm looking after his old noodle stand, and its new manager.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: Can do! This synthetic chicken is so fresh, you might expect it to come back to life. But... it won't.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can do! This synthetic chicken is so fresh, you might expect it to come back to life. But... it won't.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: Can do! This synthetic pork is so fresh, you might expect it to come back to life. But... it won't.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can do! This synthetic pork is so fresh, you might expect it to come back to life. But... it won't.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't know where Thaddeus is.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't know where Thaddeus is.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't know where Thaddeus is.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't know where Thaddeus is.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: People keep coming back, so that's good.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: People keep coming back, so that's good.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: People keep coming back, so that's good.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: People keep coming back, so that's good.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Like an ousted Corpster.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Like an ousted Corpster.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You want money, right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You want money, right?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do you want?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you want?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: We are always running out of onions.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We are always running out of onions.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: We are always running out of onions.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: We are always running out of onions.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What's the cost?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's the cost?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I can't turn down that price.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can't turn down that price.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I can't turn down that price.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I can't turn down that price.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Chicken is always in demand.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Chicken is always in demand.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: We were looking for good pork belly.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We were looking for good pork belly.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: We were looking for good pork belly.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: We were looking for good pork belly.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's really cheap.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's really cheap.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I can do that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can do that.
